title: vanitypages configuration
description: Configuration for the vanitypages static Go vanity import site generator.

$schema.description: Reference to this JSON Schema, used by editors.

domain.description: Host the site is served from, optionally with a path. Import paths start with this value.

title.description: Index page heading. Defaults to the domain.

description.description: Text shown at the top of the index page.

icon.description: Path of an image shown in the header and as the favicon, relative to the config file.

docs.description: Base URL of the documentation site. Import paths are appended to it.

modules.description: Modules served from the domain, listed in this order on the index page.

packages.description: Package paths inside the module, relative to its root, that should get a page of their own. In a module with versions, the pages are for the newest major version.

module.description: A Go module whose root is the root of a repository.

path.description: Module path relative to the domain. The first element can't be "-", which is reserved for generated assets.

description.description: Text shown on the index and module pages.

versions.description: Major versions above v1 developed at the repository root, with a go.mod declaring the /vN module path. Each one gets a page, and the module's page advertises the newest. For a major version kept in its own directory, use a submodule.

submodules.description: Go modules with their own go.mod nested in this module's repository, tagged with their directory as a prefix, such as contrib/redis/v1.2.3.

hidden.description: Keep the module off the index page. Its pages are still generated, so it remains importable.

submodule.description: A Go module nested in the parent module's repository.

path.description: Path relative to the parent module. This is also the module's directory in the repository.

description.description: Text shown on the parent module's page and on the submodule's own page.

source.description: URL templates for source links. Detected automatically for repositories on github.com, gitlab.com, bitbucket.org and codeberg.org.

home.description: URL of the repository's home page.

dir.description: URL template of a directory. Placeholders: {dir}, {/dir}.

file.description: URL template of a file line. Placeholders: {dir}, {/dir}, {file}, {line}.
